name: tracker-native-local-api
goal: Serve core Tracker loopback item reads and writes through the native SQLite journal, with legacy HTTP shapes and isolated replication proof.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Pinned 4a6be709 loopback request/response contract. Accept list, item detail, digest, duplicate check and journal mutations in isolated SQLite without effectful fleet adapters. Prove JSON/text, status, actor/note persistence, duplicate rejection without writes and propagation through the signed hub.
